image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a baked meatloaf in a metal baking pan. The meatloaf has been sliced, revealing a dense, textured interior with visible flecks of ingredients (likely onions or breadcrumbs) and some yellow corn kernels mixed in or adjacent. The exterior is browned with a glossy, reddish-brown glaze on top. In the foreground, out of focus, there appears to be a side dish, possibly macaroni and cheese or corn casserole, and a serving utensil (knife or spatula) is partially visible cutting into the scene.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The foreground elements (yellow side dish and knife handle) are significantly out of focus. While this may be intentional depth-of-field, the transition is somewhat abrupt and the texture of the side dish is indistinct, which is common in AI generations struggling with secondary objects.

The texture of the meat interior is slightly 'mushy' or overly uniform in some areas, lacking the distinct individual strands of ground meat often seen in high-resolution real photos, though it passes at this resolution.

The serving utensil in the foreground lacks clear structural definition. The blade seems to merge with the food and the handle geometry is ambiguous, suggesting a failure to render rigid object physics correctly.
